title: Figure 12: SEM of EV damage to ceramic plate (20 um scale)
description: Black-and-white scanning electron microscope image of an aluminum-oxide ceramic plate showing a smooth, bright vertical channel bored through the pitted grey surface, with a "20UM" scale bar at lower left. Caption: "Figure 12. SEM of EV Damage to Ceramic Plate (20 um scale) (Reference 36)." The text above states the channel was produced by a single EV burst fired along the plate.
